t: An open USB tool for listening to and talking with the chips inside gadgets.
steps: Buy the Glasgow revC3 from 1BitSquared or Mouser. The list price is about 179 US dollars.
Get a USB-C cable to connect it to your computer.
Install Python and pipx on your computer.
Install the Glasgow software with pipx by following the official manual.
Run the glasgow flash command to load the latest firmware and safety fix.
Try the UART applet on a simple serial device first.
Move on to the 25-series flash applet and back up a memory chip.
meta: Wild Open. From $157. A few stores.
